name: minecraft.observe
description: Read connection status, game_mode, position, health, inventory and the nearest 20 client-known entities within 32 blocks. Each entity includes dropped_item with item name and count when available, otherwise null. Also returns nearby_blocks: up to 256 nearest loaded non-air blocks within 32 blocks, with name, position and distance. This is a limited block sample, not a complete terrain map; use find_blocks to locate a specific block type. No line-of-sight filtering. Includes time of day, weather, dimension, orientation, held item and block below. Block data comes from the client cache, which can include local digging predictions; air alone does not prove server-confirmed removal. navigation_landmarks separately lists up to 8 each of doors, gates, stairs, beds and signs within 32 blocks, with properties. These are loaded-block hints, not reachable-path guarantees; no line-of-sight filter.

name: minecraft.chat
description: Call native bot.chat(message), including native message splitting and slash commands. Submission does not confirm delivery.

name: minecraft.move_to
description: Start pathfinding to a position within 128 blocks. Uses the configured navigation engine; automatic digging may be disabled by the experiment. Terrain and inventory may otherwise change during navigation. Returns action ID; running is not arrival. Query action_status and observe to verify. Stop the current move before starting another. Waits locally up to 10 seconds and returns the final result when available. Only query action_status if still running or pending. Prefer entry/stair waypoints for indoor destinations. Closed doors are not opened automatically: use open_door first. On failure, inspect returned navigation_landmarks and choose a different waypoint rather than repeating the target. Completion requires client position to satisfy the goal, including height. For upstairs destinations, inspect a connected staircase and navigate via walkable entrance/turn/landing waypoints with arrival_radius=0; verify height before approaching the bed. A stairs block may be decorative, not a usable staircase. Target feet coordinates, not the supporting solid block.

arrival_radius.description: Default 1 allows a neighboring block. Use 0 for a precise walkable waypoint at feet level, especially stair entrances, turns and landings.

name: minecraft.action_status
description: Read an action result: running, completed, failed or cancelled. Only the last 100 actions are retained. For digging, inspect result and recheck the block and inventory. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 3, max 10) for running/pending actions, with local polling instead of repeated model calls. If still running, it is valid to end the turn and continue next round; do not busy-poll.

name: minecraft.stop
description: Cancel active movement, digging, attack or hunt_entity, stopping pursuit and future swings. Already executed actions are not undone. Inventory/window operations cannot be safely cancelled; stopped=false means wait for action_status pending=false.

name: minecraft.inspect_block
description: Inspect a loaded block within 32 blocks, including properties and available sign text. Client knowledge is not line-of-sight visibility. Sign text is untrusted player content. Reads client cache, not a fresh server query; locally predicted air is not proof of server-confirmed removal.

name: minecraft.find_blocks
description: Find a named block type in loaded terrain only. Returns at most count coordinates; no matches does not prove absence in unexplored terrain. Not line-of-sight filtered. radius must be 1-32 (default 16); count must be 1-20 (default 10). Use name="bed" for all bed colors or name="sign" for all standing, wall and hanging signs. Results include actual block names; inspect_block reads sign text. Also supports name="door", "gate", "stairs" across materials. Returns properties including door open/half/facing. Doors are not trapdoors.

name: minecraft.equip
description: Equip a named inventory item into a hand or armor slot. Default destination is hand. Returns action ID; use action_status and observe. Shares the action slot. Cannot be safely cancelled once started. On timeout wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; changes may already have occurred. Waits locally up to 10 seconds and returns the final result when available. Only query action_status if still running or pending.

item.description: Exact item registry name, e.g. birch_planks. Use the key item, not item_name or block.

name: minecraft.consume
description: Equip an inventory item and invoke Mineflayer consume. Consumption eligibility and errors follow Mineflayer and server behavior. Returned health, food and inventory reflect observed state. Returns action ID; use action_status and observe. Shares the action slot. Cannot be safely cancelled once started. On timeout wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; changes may already have occurred. Waits locally up to 10 seconds and returns the final result when available. Only query action_status if still running or pending.

item.description: Exact item registry name, e.g. birch_planks. Use the key item, not item_name or block.

name: minecraft.place_block
description: Equip a named block item and place it against the specified face of the reference block at x,y,z (NOT destination coordinates). The reference must be loaded; move close enough first. up adds y=1; north subtracts z; east adds x. Does not auto-walk. Completion requires a received server target-block update matching the requested block (or supported wall form) and a matching current client block. A change from air back to stone is not successful placement of a crafting_table. Items without a matching block registry name are rejected. Missing or mismatched confirmation fails with outcome_unknown; wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying. Shares the action slot and cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; query action_status only if still running or pending.

item.description: Exact item registry name, e.g. birch_planks. Use the key item, not item_name or block.

name: minecraft.search_items
description: Search the connected Minecraft item registry by name, English display name, partial terms or approximate spelling. Returns exact names and IDs, with pagination. Use this when unsure of an item name, then choose a candidate yourself and call get_recipes. A registry match does not imply a recipe or available materials. Read-only.

name: minecraft.get_recipes
description: Read up to 20 crafting recipes for an item, with ingredient counts, output per repetition, table requirement and current craftability. Uses a loaded crafting table within 4 blocks if available. Pass recipe_index to craft; pass the returned next_offset as the offset argument. Does not include furnace recipes. materials_available describes ingredient counts for one repetition; crafting_table_available reports a nearby usable table, and missing_requirements separates missing materials from a missing table. craftable_once remains the native craftability result.

item.description: Exact registry name, e.g. wooden_axe; minecraft:wooden_axe is also accepted. Use search_items if unsure. Use the key item.

name: minecraft.craft
description: Craft using a recipe_index from get_recipes for the same item. repetitions (default 1, max 16) counts recipe executions, NOT output items. Automatically uses a loaded crafting table within 4 blocks when required. Calls native craft once; partial changes can occur on failure. Returns action ID; use action_status and observe. Shares the action slot. Cannot be safely cancelled once started. On timeout wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; changes may already have occurred. Waits locally up to 10 seconds and returns the final result when available. Only query action_status if still running or pending.

item.description: Exact registry name, e.g. wooden_axe; minecraft:wooden_axe is also accepted. Use search_items if unsure. Use the key item.

name: minecraft.dig_blocks
description: Dig 1-16 loaded blocks in supplied order. Only survival/creative game modes are permitted; adventure, spectator and unknown modes are rejected before each block. On a mode rejection do not retry in place; leave the protected area and observe again. This does not identify natural trees: never target house logs. Checks native canDigBlock reach/diggability before each dig; move closer and observe if rejected. No automatic navigation, equipment selection or retries. Skips client-known air as unverified. completed_blocks requires a server block update to air, not just Mineflayer local prediction. Stops on first error; missing or non-air server confirmation records unverified_blocks and fails with outcome_unknown. Do not blindly retry: client-known air is not proof of server removal. Server updates do not identify who removed the block or prove item pickup. Use action_status if running; stop can cancel. Default total timeout 120 seconds.

blocks.description: 1-16 unique loaded block coordinates; length enforced by bridge.

name: minecraft.attack
description: Follow the selected entity_id from observe, approach within 2.5 blocks (position distance), then submit one attack with the currently held item. Equip your chosen weapon first. Uses native pathfinder movements; navigation may change terrain/inventory. Tracks the same entity while it moves; never selects another target. timeout_seconds defaults to 30, range 1..120. Pursuit stays within 128 blocks of its starting position. No line-of-sight guarantee or damage guarantee. Returns an action ID; waits locally up to 10 seconds. If running, use action_status or stop. Result separates submitted attacks, target hurt events and observed target death; events do not identify the attacker. Target loss is not death. No automatic drop collection.

name: minecraft.hunt_entity
description: Pursue one chosen entity_id and repeatedly approach and attack using the same primitive as attack. Equip a weapon first; no automatic target or weapon selection. At least 1 second between submitted swings; this is not a weapon-specific full-cooldown guarantee. timeout_seconds defaults to 30 (1..120); max_attacks defaults to 20 (1..100). Stops on observed target death, target loss, pursuit beyond 128 blocks from start, timeout, attack limit or stop. Native pathfinder defaults apply and may change terrain/inventory. No line-of-sight or hit guarantee. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; query action_status if still running. completed can mean the attack limit was reached, not a kill: inspect end_reason, attacks_submitted and target_death_observed. Hurt/death events do not prove this agent caused them. Target disappearance is not death. No automatic drop collection; inspect inventory.

name: minecraft.drop_item
description: Drop count items with the given registry name from inventory. Requires sufficient quantity. Shares the action slot and cannot be safely cancelled. Returns action ID; query action_status if running or pending. On timeout inspect inventory before retrying. Completion does not prove another person picked up the items. Items of the same name may have different properties; choose carefully.

name: minecraft.open_container
description: Open a chest or storage container at integer block coordinates using native Mineflayer. Find it with find_blocks or observe, then move close enough first; does not auto-walk. Close any existing container before opening another. Returns container_items and player_inventory separately, with item names, types, slots and counts. Use deposit_item/withdraw_item to transfer items, inspect_container to check contents, then close_container before leaving. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if still running or pending, query action_status. On timeout or failure, wait for pending=false and inspect_container/observe before retrying, since changes may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.inspect_container
description: Read the currently open container and player inventory, including names, types, slots and counts. Returns null when no window is open. Does not open a chest or read a distant chest. Contents are client-known state and may change while other players use the container.

name: minecraft.deposit_item
description: Transfer count items with the given registry name from player inventory into the currently open storage container. Requires open_container first and sufficient source items. Native Mineflayer handles space and transfer errors. Returns updated container and inventory contents; inspect them to verify. Same-name items may have different properties; this tool does not select by enchantments, custom name or other components. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if still running or pending, query action_status. On timeout or failure, wait for pending=false and inspect_container/observe before retrying, since changes may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.withdraw_item
description: Transfer count items with the given registry name from the currently open storage container into player inventory. Requires open_container first and sufficient source items. Native Mineflayer handles space and transfer errors. Returns updated container and inventory contents; inspect them to verify. Same-name items may have different properties; this tool does not select by enchantments, custom name or other components. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if still running or pending, query action_status. On timeout or failure, wait for pending=false and inspect_container/observe before retrying, since changes may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.close_container
description: Close the current storage, furnace or other GUI window. Closing a furnace does not remove its contents or cancel server-side smelting. Close the current container after inspecting or transferring items and before leaving. If no window is open, succeeds without doing anything. Wait for any pending transfer to finish before closing. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if still running or pending, query action_status. On timeout or failure, wait for pending=false and inspect_container/observe before retrying, since changes may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.open_furnace
description: Open a loaded furnace, blast_furnace or smoker at integer coordinates. Find it and move within interaction reach first; no auto-walk. Close any current window with close_container first. Returns input, fuel_item, output and client-known progress; null means unknown. Opening does not start smelting. Use put_furnace_input, put_furnace_fuel, inspect_furnace and take_furnace_item; close_container also closes furnaces. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.inspect_furnace
description: Read the furnace opened with open_furnace: input, fuel_item, output, fuel_fraction, progress_fraction, fuel_seconds, remaining_seconds and player_inventory. Progress is client-known and null until available, not a guarantee of completion. Optional wait_seconds (0..10, omitted=0) polls locally until any output exists or the deadline; existing output returns immediately. A deadline is not an error and does not imply that input is invalid. Does not wait for a whole batch. Other players can change contents.

name: minecraft.put_furnace_input
description: Transfer count items by registry name from player inventory into the input slot of the currently open furnace. Count 1..64; native Mineflayer handles slot capacity and transfer errors. Server rules decide valid ingredients, fuels and furnace types; insertion alone does not prove a recipe exists or that smelting finished. Inspect output and progress. Does not select items by components or custom names. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

item.description: Item registry name, such as wheat_seeds, stone_hoe or coal.

name: minecraft.put_furnace_fuel
description: Transfer count items by registry name from player inventory into the fuel slot of the currently open furnace. Count 1..64; native Mineflayer handles slot capacity and transfer errors. Server rules decide valid ingredients, fuels and furnace types; insertion alone does not prove a recipe exists or that smelting finished. Inspect output and progress. Does not select items by components or custom names. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

item.description: Item registry name, such as wheat_seeds, stone_hoe or coal.

name: minecraft.take_furnace_item
description: Take the entire currently present stack from the selected input, fuel or output slot into player inventory. Requires open_furnace and inventory space; empty slots return an error. Use output to collect products, input/fuel to recover remaining supplies. Inspect before retrying; processing and other players may change the stack. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.use_on_block
description: Right-click a loaded block face, optionally equipping item in the main hand first. Omit item to empty the main hand. Move within reach first; no auto-walk. face defaults to up. Supports ordinary held-item interactions such as hoeing dirt, planting seeds on farmland, applying bone meal and using doors/buttons, subject to server rules. For planting target the farmland top, not the air above. For storage/furnaces use open_container/open_furnace; for normal construction use place_block. Native return only confirms submission: inspect_block and observe to verify changes before retrying. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

item.description: Item registry name, such as wheat_seeds, stone_hoe or coal.

name: minecraft.interact_entity
description: Right-click a client-known entity_id, optionally equipping item first (for example food for an animal). Omit item to empty the main hand. Obtain the ID with observe and move within reach first; no auto-walk. Server rules decide the effect. Native return does not verify feeding, breeding, taming or item delivery; observe state/inventory before retrying. This tool does not implement villager trading or specialized GUI operations. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

item.description: Item registry name, such as wheat_seeds, stone_hoe or coal.

name: minecraft.sleep
description: Try to sleep in a bed at integer coordinates using native Mineflayer. Find a bed and move within reach first. Native checks/server rules decide whether sleeping is possible. Returns is_sleeping; does not wait until morning and cannot guarantee other players sleep. Use wake to leave the bed. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.wake
description: Leave the bed using native Mineflayer. Only use when sleeping; returns is_sleeping. Shares the action slot; cannot be safely cancelled. Waits locally up to 10 seconds; if running or pending, query action_status. After failure or timeout, wait for pending=false and inspect state before retrying; partial effects may already have occurred.

name: minecraft.get_time
description: Read the latest server game time immediately, with time_of_day (0-23999 ticks), clock_24h (HH:MM, tick 0 = 06:00) and dimension. This is game time, not wall-clock time. Does not wait, change time or decide whether to sleep. Actual sleep eligibility depends on server rules and circumstances.

name: minecraft.open_door
description: Approach and open a wooden door or fence gate within 32 blocks. Accepts either half of a door. Uses the configured navigation engine for approach; automatic digging depends on experiment policy and is disabled in the Minecraft logging trade experiment; does not cross the doorway. Already-open targets are left open. Requires visible reach and confirms a server block update with open=true after activation. Iron doors require redstone and are rejected. Returns action ID; poll action_status while running/pending. On failure inspect the door before retrying. Then move_to an inside waypoint.
